Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

Even though science is a subject that's required for all public school students, one teacher noticed that some of her Christian students had a different reaction to their science classes compared to her Hindu students. The Christian students tended to do very well in the subject and really saw how science understanding can improve aspects of their own lives, but the Hindu students argued with every lesson, didn't retain much info, and generally rejected everything they were taught. Who rejects science?
A. Not enough info
B. The Hindu students
C. The Christian students
